messages:
maria (eng-infra): heads-up: incident bot failed to fully page oncall for the last 10m, users report missed pages. looks like webhook timeouts from pager-proxy -> notify gateway (504).
inc-bot: delivery summary: 3/5 pages succeeded, 2/5 timed out (upstream 504). request_id=da3f2b.
eli (oncall): i missed an alert, my phone never rang. i was on-shift, no do-not-disturb.
jordan (sre): i'm looking at notify-gateway logs now. seeing a spike of 504s starting 12:03 UTC, coincides with a deploy? checking deploy history.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollouts/notify-gateway v2.14 started at 12:00 UTC, health checks passed.
sam (swe): fwiw, last rolling deploy touched the webhook handler (retry/backoff) and a header parsing tweak. i'll pull the canary.
maria (eng-infra): confirmed partial fanout: EU region got pages, US region had timeouts. looks like a routing rule mismatch in proxy.
katie (support): we've had two customers ping support about not getting paged. both US-based. escalating thread to customer-impacts channel.
jordan (sre): grabbing logs: snippet:
```
ERROR notify.gateway: upstream response 504 for /v1/pagerfwd (req=da3f2b)
stack=net.http: timeout after 5s
headers: x-region: us-west-2 x-route: pager-proxy-v2
```
eli (oncall): can someone manually page the oncall until this is fixed? we're in primary oncall rotation.
maria (eng-infra): manual pages sent by ops (sms) to the missed contacts. please confirm receipt.
inc-bot: manual override: paging disabled for routing group 'us-primary' until flagged cleared. reason=partial-timeout.
sam (swe): quick mitigation: revert the header parsing change or route US traffic to previous proxy cluster. i'll open a revert PR now.
jordan (sre): running quick health check command: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://notify-gateway.internal/health` -> `200 0.03s` on canary, but upstream webhook calls still 504.
maria (eng-infra): found misconfigured upstream timeout override in proxy config for us-west (2s). that explains timeouts at scale. increasing to 8s as a temporary mitigation. pushing config patch.
ops-bot: config change applied to us-west proxy: timeout=8s. rollout started.
jordan (sre): after patch, delivery retry success: inc-bot delivery summary: 5/5 succeeded for new attempts.
eli (oncall): confirmed phone rung for the manual page. good to go.
katie (support): notified affected customers: email sent, apologizing and offering incident updates.
sam (swe): opened PR to fully revert parsing change and add an e2e for webhook timeout header. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/notify/1234
maria (eng-infra): creating incident ticket and postmortem stub. impact: partial paging failure for ~12 minutes (12:03–12:15 UTC), ~2 customers reported missed pages, oncall manual fallback used. root cause: proxy timeout override + deploy. remediation: revert change, add canary traffic test, add alert when inc-bot delivery rate < 95% over 5m.
jordan (sre): tagging for postmortem: @maria @sam @ops @eli. I'll collect traces and add to the ticket.
eli (oncall): thanks. if anything else pops up i'll post here. :thumbsup:
maria (eng-infra): follow-up action items: 1) revert PR + e2e (sam), 2) add delivery-rate alert (jordan), 3) add region-aware chaos test (maria), 4) customer comms follow-through (katie).
inc-bot: incident note appended: "partial paging outage (us region) - mitigated by proxy timeout patch and manual SMS fallback".
ops-bot: incident assigned to oncall-runbook queue. playbook link: https://confluence.internal/incidents/paging-playbook
maria (eng-infra): closing thread for now — will update when postmortem draft ready.
